gains.tr: Kanada'da ana iş dışı, kullanılmayan bir varlığın satış kazancı: 2,4 milyon dolar, vergi sonrası 1,7 milyon dolar
gains.en: Gain on disposition of a non-core redundant asset in Canadian Operations: 2.4 million dollars, 1.7 million after tax
gains.how: 1.726 / 141.7; after-tax amount from the company's adjusted net earnings reconciliation

NWC.notes: TTM cross-check: the eight-quarter table in the Q1 2026 report gives diluted EPS Q3 2025 0.82, Q4 2025 0.78, Q1 2026 0.56; plus Q2 2026 0.76 = 2.92, same as FY - H1 + H1. Source check: 58.47 / 20.01 = 2.92 per share; 2,768.9 / 20.01 = 138.4m vs 141.7m document (source lower, 2.4%). Attributable net earnings: FY2025 139.485m (annual report), H1 2025 61.929m (Q2 2025 report), Q1 2026 27.3m (Q1 2026 report), Q2 2026 36.8m (Q2 release via stockwatch full text; not the company PDF). GAINS: two disposal gains inside the 12 months, both singled out by the company in its adjusted-earnings reconciliation; together 4.726m after tax = 3.3% of TTM attributable profit, just above the 3% threshold. The after-tax amounts are consolidated; whether any part belongs to non-controlling interests is not disclosed, so the full amounts are used (rule: no disclosed share -> full consolidated amount). OFFSETS left empty on purpose: the company's 'Next 100 one-time costs' (after tax: Q1 2026 1.4m, Q2 2026 0.986m; FY2025 6.4m pre-tax, of which H1 2025 3.769m pre-tax) appear in fiscal 2024 (1.0m), 2025 and 2026, i.e. three years running, so under the reading rule they are ordinary costs. If the main session prefers to count them, the TTM amount is about 2.386m (H1 2026, after tax) + 2.63m pre-tax for H2 2025 (about 1.97m at 25.3%) = about 4.35m, 3.1% of profit, which would almost cancel the gains. Also not counted: 1.1m 'non-comparable withholding tax' in Q2 2026 (a tax expense, not labelled one-time). Share-based compensation is recurring (12.7m pre-tax in FY2025). Tax rate 25.3% = Q1 2026 effective rate (Q1 report). No EPS guidance.

ET.notes: FY2026 figures from the year-end release of 24 Jun 2026 (newsfile 302735); Q1 FY2026 and Q1 FY2027 from the Q1 release of 14 Sep 2026. Basic TTM EPS: 0.85 - 0.16 + 0.10 = 0.79. Check against the source: 12.99 / 16.59 = 0.783; 999.5m / 16.59 = 60.2m vs 59.9m (within 1%). Tax rate 25.9% = Q1 FY2027 (2,780 / 10,740). NO ONE-OFF GAINS found in the 12 months: the FY2026 release reports none; 'other income and expenses' was 39k in Q1 FY2027 (500k in Q1 FY2026, outside the window). FX: FY2026 net loss of 421k; Q1 FY2027 loss of 531k (recurring item, not a one-off). The 1.00 special dividend (75.5m) affects cash and equity, not profit. No EPS guidance.

CMG.notes: FY2026 net income 17,416k and EPS 0.21 from the Q4 release (21 May 2026) and the FY2026 financial report; 6M figures from the Q2 FY2027 release (12 Nov 2026). No non-controlling interest. Quarterly net income: Q3 FY26 5,964k, Q4 FY26 5,427k, Q1 FY27 1,325k (2,036 - 711), Q2 FY27 711k; sum 13,427k. EPS from cent-rounded figures; exact TTM EPS depends on share count (weighted basic shares fell from about 80.5m in Q4 FY26 to 75.6m in Q2 FY27). Check against the source: 4.32 / 25.84 = 0.167 vs 0.17 (ok). Market cap / P/E = 306.1 / 25.84 = 11.85m vs document 13.43m: the document is HIGHER, because the source's market cap uses the post-buyback share count (about 70.9m = 306.1 / 4.32, not confirmed in a document) while the profit was earned on more shares; no cut applies. ONE-OFF GAINS: none above threshold. 'Other income' of 211k in Q2 FY27 (0.3m insurance proceeds were received on the fraud) and a 126k contingent-consideration gain in Q2 FY26 (outside the window). Offset: fraud loss 790k pre-tax. Acquisition costs (171k in 6M FY27; 973k FY26) recur every year and are treated as ordinary. No EPS guidance.

gains.tr: Diğer kazançlar (net): 3,99 milyon dolar vergi öncesi; şirkete göre büyük bölümü Raisr bölümünün varlıklarının satışından (24 Temmuz 2026)
gains.en: Other gains, net: 3.99 million dollars pre-tax; according to the company mainly from the sale of the assets of the Raisr division (24 July 2026)
gains.how: 3.99 x (1 - 0.256) / 17.16; pre-tax amount from the company, converted at the nine-month effective tax rate (18.05 - 13.43) / 18.05 = 25.6%

OLY.notes: CAUTION ON BASIS: FY2025 (19.86m; EPS 8.25; annual report) is total net earnings INCLUDING the later-discontinued CGP business (2025 net loss 1.08m), while both nine-month columns are continuing operations (2025 restated). So the implied Q4 2025 (3.73m) carries CGP's Q4 loss; the TTM is slightly understated versus a pure continuing basis. Results of discontinued operations in 2026 (including any gain or loss on the CGP sale) are NOT in the releases and were not found. Universe 'per' is 2026-Q2: TTM to June 2026 would be 19.86 - 11.25 + 7.06 = 15.67m, EPS 8.25 - 4.67 + 2.93 = 6.51; source implies 108.78 / 16.59 = 6.56 (within 1%), so the source and the documents agree on the June basis. I used the September TTM because the Q3 release (13 Nov 2026) is the latest document and it contains the Raisr gain; on the June basis there is no gain to deduct. After the gain, September TTM is about 14.2m, below the June TTM, so the deduction is not double counting. Shares: 2,406,336 (Stockwatch page, Aug 2026); 17.16 / 2.406 = 7.13 ok. Universe market cap 257.0 / 108.78 = 2.36m shares, about 2% below the company's count. Tax rate 25.6% from the 9M release. PENDING: the plan of arrangement (cash 44.9m + 433,493 shares to Tarman and executives, total value 49.747m) will, when it closes, likely produce a large charge and change the share count and compensation cost; nothing about its accounting is in the releases. No EPS guidance.
